extracted.name: Vegetable Beef Soup II
extracted.description: A soup of ground beef and stewed tomatoes simmered with onions, carrots, potatoes and celery in beef bouillon seasoned with thyme, bay leaf, and basil.
instruction_lines: In a large stock pot brown sirloin and onion. Drain grease and add tomatoes, water, salt, beef bouillon, carrots, celery, potatoes, thyme, bay leaf and basil. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender, approximately 45 minutes.
